column1: # idn-hostname acceptance vectors.
# Source: curated from RFC 5890/5891 (IDNA2008) example text and the UTS-46
# lookup profile as implemented by golang.org/x/net/idna (idna.Lookup), which
# the idn-hostname validator delegates to. Pinned to golang.org/x/net v0.56.0
# (jsonschema/go.mod), the same module the validator compiles against.
# This is a curated subset, not the full Unicode IdnaTestV2.txt corpus.
# IdnaTestV2.txt records per-row toUnicode/toASCII outputs and status codes for
# both the transitional and non-transitional profiles; reducing those columns to
# one accept/reject for this validator needs its own mapping logic. The
# validator also layers RFC 5890/5891 structure on top of the idna.Lookup pass:
# label and total-length limits, the RFC 1123 numeric-TLD ban, and the
# trailing-dot and empty-label rules, none of which the corpus's raw conversion
# status captures. These vectors lock the accept/reject boundary the validator
# actually implements; consuming the full corpus would be a separate rig.
# Format: <input>\t<valid>   (valid is "true" or "false"); '#' lines are comments.
